nodes.label: Bullish-Only Implementation Scope
nodes.rationale: The bearish mirror is deferred until explicit user approval to avoid assuming directional symmetry.

nodes.label: Module Calculation Ownership
nodes.rationale: Reaction, Blue Line, A, S, E, and StopAll retain calculation ownership while the leg layer supplies context, validity, ownership, and lineage.

nodes.label: Range Isolation Semantics
nodes.rationale: Raw rows are isolated isolated to the selected half-open range before aggregation so outside state cannot influence module calculations.

nodes.label: Python calculation pipeline and chart workstation
nodes.norm_label: python calculation pipeline and chart workstation

nodes.label: Presentation-Only Test Isolation
nodes.rationale: The browser fixture explicitly excludes trading calculations and API calls so the test isolates manual-review presentation behavior.

nodes.label: No Historical Hardcoding Rule
nodes.rationale: Historical ranges, source filenames, and expected events cannot be hard-coded to alter production behavior.

nodes.label: Clarification Before Implementation
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous eligibility, windows, strictness, event order, reset behavior, or directional mirroring must be clarified before source changes.

nodes.label: Formalize Before Source Change
nodes.rationale: A confirmed rule is formalized before implementation and specifications, modules, bridge, tests, and AI documentation move together.

nodes.label: Workstation Application Shell
nodes.rationale: Provides a minimal HTML shell whose app container is populated by the main JavaScript module.

nodes.label: Chronological Dominant-Owner Selection
nodes.rationale: The latest stop-containing main candle is selected before same-candle module priority and sequence-number tie breaking.

nodes.label: Live Invalid-Head Order_B Ownership
nodes.rationale: An invalid bullish head with a pending S candidate retains its lifecycle until its exact strict stop.

nodes.label: Range Contract
nodes.rationale: Filtering before aggregation ensures a selected range behaves exactly like an isolated physical input file and prevents prior state from leaking into the calculation.

nodes.label: Bearish Order Authority
nodes.rationale: Bullish S and E require bearish Reaction and Reset geometry as the authoritative opposing Order lifecycle.

nodes.label: Blue Spacing Lock
nodes.rationale: At least one complete healthy Reaction without a Blue must separate published Blues, while suppressed scales still advance comparison state.

nodes.label: Browser Rendering Boundary
nodes.rationale: Python owns calculation truth; the browser may render, filter visibility, and retain presentation overrides but must not recompute indicator rules.

nodes.label: Decimal and Strict-Crossing Contract
nodes.rationale: Decimal arithmetic, string serialization, and strict inequalities preserve exact price semantics; equality is deliberately not a break or stop.

nodes.label: Dual-Resolution Chronology
nodes.rationale: Main candles establish coarse ownership while lower-second events resolve the true order of competing breaks, stops, resets, and candidate crossings.

nodes.label: E StopAll Fixed Point Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: StopAll boundaries reset E sequence state, so E and StopAll must be recomputed until reset identities stabilize; cycles are errors rather than publish incomplete output.

nodes.label: Engine Content Cache Fingerprint
nodes.rationale: The cache includes hashes of all active calculation files and request dimensions so stale or mid-calculation engine results are not served.

nodes.label: Helper-Specific Extrema Tie Rules
nodes.rationale: Different helpers intentionally preserve either the first or last equal extreme, so a pipeline-wide tie rule would alter provenance and behavior.

nodes.label: Isolated Virtual File Range
nodes.rationale: Raw rows are filtered to the half-open range before aggregation so no earlier or later row, parent, state, or ownership can enter the selected calculation.

nodes.label: Order Cause Merging
nodes.rationale: Parent-stop, reset-leg, and carried-live causes for one physical First/Break identity are merged so one geometry is not counted as multiple Orders.

nodes.label: Parity Validation Requirements
nodes.rationale: Independent implementations and optimizations must be compared collection-by-collection and field-by-field, including exact Decimal strings, event times, ownership, lineage, and causes.

nodes.label: Provenance and Ownership Contract
nodes.rationale: Source, decision, parent, event, and cause provenance must remain distinct to prevent look-ahead and preserve downstream ownership.

nodes.label: Runtime Authority
nodes.rationale: The current TradingBot executable code is authoritative when older descriptions or the Prj-1 checkout disagree.

nodes.label: A and S Confirmation Lookup Cache
nodes.rationale: Repeated Reaction confirmation-time lookups are cached within each detector.
nodes.norm_label: a and s confirmation lookup cache

nodes.label: Bridge Geometry Reuse
nodes.rationale: Duplicate Reaction detection was eliminated so one geometry result can serve serialization and downstream modules.

nodes.label: E Shared Search Indexes
nodes.rationale: E instances share the sorted lower-candle list, timestamp index, strict-cross index, and cached candidate searches to reduce dominant search time while preserving returned objects.

nodes.label: Reaction Shared Indexes
nodes.rationale: Timestamp indexes and lazy reflected candle views are shared for identical immutable candle sequences to avoid repeated construction.

nodes.label: Verification Artifacts Authority Boundary
nodes.rationale: Generated benchmark files are diagnostic evidence only; maintained code, algorithm documents, and tests remain authoritative.
